notes.title: TCM RACING 2: Linux Patch Update
notes.notes: The patch 2 update has been applied to Linux users.

notes.title: TCM RACING 2 Patch 2 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Following changes:[/h1]

[b]*slight [/b]improvement on performance

- [i]Added a 1 new existing vehicle into Multiplayer[/i]
- [i]Fixed Display tab not being displayed in Settings[/i]
- [i]Added a way to get back to main menu shortly from Benchmark[/i]
- [i]Saved Audio volume now gets actually set.[/i]
- [i]Fixed UI Scaling on Quick Menu & Mode Designer on higher displays.[/i]
- [i][b]Fixed missing ui issue on main menu (Common)[/b][/i]


More questions? join our discord: 
https://discord.gg/eshuHVQ

notes.title: Day 2 patch notes
notes.notes:
Greetings! if you're not able to play TCM RACING 2, or get inside any game mode, now I assume you can!


The main reason was because of a conflict with discord. It is no longer required to have discord open before having TCM RACING 2 launched.

SRFB Car now has audio.

Mode Designer UI disappearing on load was solved.
